state.seed_assertion: Controllers must conduct a review to assess if processing complies with the data protection impact assessment when there is a change in the risk represented by processing operations.

sentences.1: We carry out a new DPIA if there is a change to the nature, scope, context or purposes of our processing.
sentences.2: If you have determined that the processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects, you must carry out a data protection impact assessment (DPIA) for each processing operation.
sentences.3: Organizations should consult individuals and other relevant stakeholders when carrying out a DPIA.
sentences.4: Carrying out a DPIA is not a one-time exercise.
sentences.5: In some cases we may advise you not to carry out the processing because we consider it would be in breach of the GDPR.
sentences.6: A new DPIA should be carried out if there is a change to the nature, scope, context or purposes of processing.
sentences.7: Recital 91 says innovative technology concerns new developments in technological knowledge in the world at large, rather than technology that is new to you, and its use can trigger the need to carry out a DPIA.
sentences.8: A DPIA is an ongoing process subject to regular review rather than a one-off exercise.
